subject: Preliminary information about Distance workshops in St. Andrews,

messages.author: 12f269733c6eb9a2
messages.subject: Preliminary information about Distance workshops in St. Andrews,
parts:
Initial information about introductory and advanced distance sampling
workshops taking place in St. Andrews in August 2009 are located on our
website. We have not yet opened the workshops for registration, nor
have we widely advertised the workshop, but we have begun to place some
information on the site so those considering attending can begin to
organize their diaries.

http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance.workshops/workshop_overview2009.html

More details about the workshops will appear after the new year.

--
Eric Rexstad
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling
